Class UFOCat

java.lang.Object
models.base.Unit
models.base.AoeUnit
models.units.UFOCat
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attackable, Moveable
public class UFOCat extends AoeUnit
An AoE cat unit that fires a three-wave rolling explosion attack.

Stats: 2300 HP | 300 damage | 3000 ms cooldown | 210 px range | −2.5 speed.

When the attack fires, three explosions are launched sequentially with a 150 ms delay between them. Each wave covers a 70 px band of the range: wave 1 hits [0–70 px], wave 2 hits [70–140 px], wave 3 hits [140–210 px]. The rolling wave is driven by isWaveActive and currentWaveStep so it runs independently of the base AoeUnit attack loop.

    • executeWaveStep

      private void executeWaveStep(int cnt)
      Fires a single wave step: collects all enemies in the full range, then filters to those inside the current wave's band, deals damage to each, and spawns an explosion effect at the band's centre.

      Wave bands (measured from the UFOCat's centre):

      • Step 0: 0 – 70 px
      • Step 1: 70 – 140 px
      • Step 2: 140 – 210 px
      Parameters:
      cnt - the wave step index (0–2); currentWaveStep is used inside the method to compute the band boundaries
